title: Emilia Lazer-Walker - Emergent Storytelling in Physical Spaces (or, "Is Sleep No More A Roguelike?")
speaker: Emilia Lazer-Walker
talk_title: Emergent Storytelling in Physical Spaces (or, "Is Sleep No More A Roguelike?")
description:
Emilia Lazer-Walker talks about procedural generation and emergent storytelling in real-world / AR games.
This video is from the 2017 Roguelike Celebration: https://roguelike.club/event2017.html
